component.name: Car charge planner
component.summary: Charge your car on your solar power
Laad je auto op je eigen zonnestroom

description.p: Car charge planner tells you when to charge your electric car so that as much of your own solar power as possible goes into the car and as little as possible is fed back to the grid. It suits a fixed-price energy contract: it does not look at hourly energy prices.

It is advisory only: it recommends a charge window and a charge power, and you set the charge current in your charger's app yourself. It plans from a description of your home: your solar panels, your location, your charger and your car's battery.

ul.li: Turns a solar forecast from Open-Meteo or Forecast.Solar, both free and without an account, into the power your home has to spare
Recommends charge windows within the hours the car is at home, each with one constant power in amps and kilowatts
Says how much to charge from the grid, and when, if the battery would end a day too low
Shows the plan in the tray and on its dashboard, and notifies you before each charge window
Keeps everything on your computer: no account, no telemetry, and the API keys in the system keychain

description.p: The app reads nothing from the car: you enter the battery level yourself.
